question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT user_id, 
    ((date('2024-01-01') - date(birth_date)) / 365) AS age
  FROM mst_users
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN age >= 20 AND age < 30 THEN '20s'
    WHEN age >= 30 AND age < 40 THEN '30s'
    WHEN age >= 40 AND age < 50 THEN '40s'
    WHEN age >= 50 AND age < 60 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM user_ages
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY 
  CASE age_category
    WHEN '20s' THEN 1
    WHEN '30s' THEN 2
    WHEN '40s' THEN 3
    WHEN '50s' THEN 4
    WHEN 'others' THEN 5
  END
